entries.text: You shall not lie to one another.

text.text: Ye shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.
The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity, nor speak lies; neither shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth: for they shall feed and lie down, and none shall make them afraid.
Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.
Lie not one to another, seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds;

entries.text: Lying is iniquity and an abomination to God.

text.text: These six things doth the Lord hate: yea, seven are an abomination unto him:
A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,
A false witness that speaketh lies, and he that soweth discord among brethren.
Lying lips are abomination to the Lord: but they that deal truly are his delight.
But your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you, that he will not hear.
For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, your tongue hath muttered perverseness.
None calleth for justice, nor any pleadeth for truth: they trust in vanity, and speak lies; they conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity.

entries.text: We should pray to be delivered from lying lips that speak contemptuously against the righteous.

text.text: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.
Deliver my soul, O Lord, from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.

entries.text: The righteous should hate and avoid lying.

text.text: But I have trusted in thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.
I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.
A righteous man hateth lying: but a wicked man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.
For he said, Surely they are my people, children that will not lie: so he was their Saviour.
The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity, nor speak lies; neither shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth: for they shall feed and lie down, and none shall make them afraid.

entries.text: Acquiring treasures by lying is the fleeting fantasy of those who seek death.

text.text: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death.

entries.text: Should not respect or keep company with those that lie.

text.text: Blessed is that man that maketh the Lord his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.
He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.

entries.text: It is better to be a poor man than a liar.

text.text: The desire of a man is his kindness: and a poor man is better than a liar.

entries.text: Lying is a sign of apostasy.

text.text: Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;
Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;

entries.text: A lie lasts for but a moment, but truth shall be established forever.

text.text: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.

entries.text: Lying is an inherent attribute of the wicked.

text.text: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.
Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the Lord will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.
But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.
What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?
Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall not escape.
A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall perish.
A sword is upon the liars; and they shall dote: a sword is upon her mighty men; and they shall be dismayed.

But the fearful, and unbelieving, and the abominable, and murderers, and whoremongers, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone: which is the second death.
